title: Complete catalog page structuring and deepen FS3 planning evidence
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's September 6, 2026 instruction. First complete structured, rearrangeable component layouts for every active research-catalog Topic, preserving the six curated layouts and generating the remaining layouts from canonical research units and evidence-section references. Validate Japanese and English presentation, links, overflow, Coverage Gaps, and Consensus-incomplete labeling. Then proceed in order with public-source research on HPCI system lifecycle and operations gaps, power and cooling evidence, public procurement and five-year TCO boundaries, reproducible EEA1 SALMON evaluation assets, quantitative application-to-system requirements, P0 roadmap Coverage Gaps, and production-readiness checks for the recurring research loop. Stop at 2026-09-07 07:00 JST or when included Codex usage remaining reaches two percent, whichever comes first. Before stopping, commit completed work and record a resumable checkpoint. All research remains provisional single-model work with Consensus incomplete. Publish completed public-data and Pages changes through a Pull Request against main. This directive does not authorize merging the Pull Request, claiming complete Web coverage, bypassing Safe Web Fetch controls, enabling unattended production, or publishing non-public information.
